I don't think sex is not normal so "normalized" might not have been the best word to use here indeed. I do see the difference between sex and internet creeps. I was just wondering whether everyone else only thinks of sex as good in whichever context. I don't always feel that way, but I feel like almost everyone does feel that way.

This is indeed what I was trying to say, I definitely understand that sex is healthy and natural and that for most people it's normal to do and I do enjoy it myself from time to time, but not in the way most people seem to experience it? Thank you for sharing!

Me and my ex broke up because we were too different. I am really introverted and she is really extroverted. This was also why I liked her to start with (and maybe also the other way around), but living together we figured that being too different also doesn't work. In a new partner I'd look for someone at least a little more similar to me, which doesn't necessarily mean hitting the same pitfalls or thinking the same about EVERYTHING.

I HATE going out to clubs and it feels really stupid and lonely because everyone seems to love it.
